1.explanation:
1. docs/bug-repros/issue-1340/index.qmd  
   • Contains the minimal reproduction for this specific issue (zero-length caption).  
2. docs/test-knitr-options.qmd  
   • Exercises how knitr chunk options (including fig-cap) are parsed and applied.  
3. docs/crossrefs/figure-syntax-img.qmd  
   • Shows standard figure syntax and HTML output for images with captions.  
4. docs/crossrefs/figure-syntax-div.qmd  
   • Tests the alternative div-based figure syntax, illustrating how captions and wrappers are handled.  
5. docs/test-singleformat-html.qmd  
   • Validates HTML-only rendering, ensuring that figures and captions appear correctly in HTML output.  
6. docs/minimal.qmd  
   • A pared-down Quarto document to test baseline behavior without extra front matter or extensions.  

Together, these files cover the reproduction case, the underlying chunk-option mechanics for fig-cap, the figure markup pathways in HTML, and minimal vs. full document contexts needed to understand and reproduce the disappearing-figure bug.
